entries.name: Graphics/rendering patch function names
entries.description: The local graphics packet has headings for official rendering patches under Syphon Filter Dark Mirror and Resistance Retribution, and lists ApplyDepthReadback() under Official Depth Readback Usage. It does not map that function to a title or document any function's effect.
entries.source: PSP Classics Configuration Files (Official) - PS4 Developer wiki (oldid=295120)
notes: Packet: research/sources/psphd_ps4devwiki_graphics_textures.md. The packet does not list AdjustUVJitter(), AddGPUHook(), or VideoScale(); see LUA-PSPHD-001 for the separate interface-name list.
